title: Nutty British Fish Chips and Fish
description: A nutty twist on traditional British fish and chips, perfect for a hangover cure or a paleo-friendly meal option. Features ground coriander and a tangy ferment-kimchi.
instructions: Cut the cod fillets into chunks and season with salt and black pepper.
Dredge the cod chunks in tapioca starch, shaking off excess.
Dip the starch-coated cod in beaten egg and then coat in a mixture of ground coriander and chopped parsley.
Heat 1/2 cup of coconut oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the battered cod to the pan and fry for 3-4 minutes on each side or until golden brown and cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat a separate pan with 1/2 inch of coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced potatoes to the pan and fry for 5-7 minutes on each side or until crispy and golden brown.
To assemble the dish, place a portion of fried potatoes on a plate, top with a piece of fried cod, and spoon some ferment-kimchi over the top.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
